# air/OS Mobile Kit

The header is Mobile Kit version 3 from the air/OS Haiku fork, distributed
under the MIT license. Pinning the header lets airCal also build with Haiku
SDKs that predate Mobile Kit.

[Upstream header at 1b43406](https://github.com/airos-works/haiku/blob/1b434062978aed74ffa79a062faaf4d28b8966b5/headers/os/MobileKit.h)
